For a 2-night weekend from Bengaluru, these three give distinctly different experiences:

Option	Hotel/stay	Local activities	Typical 2-night cost*
Coorg	Palette Resorts - Kabini River Lodge	Coffee estates, Abbey Falls, Dubare	₹8,000–15,000 for two
Chikmagalur	Coffee-estate homestay/resort	Mullayanagiri, Baba Budangiri, waterfalls, plantation walks	₹7,000–14,000
Sakleshpur	Machaan Plantation Resort	Manjarabad Fort, Bisle Ghat, estate walks	₹6,000–12,000

What differentiates them: Coorg offers the broadest mix of sightseeing and relaxed plantation stays; Chikmagalur combines coffee country with higher-altitude scenery and trekking; Sakleshpur is the shorter-drive, quieter option focused on greenery and plantation experiences. Current guides put approximate drives at 5–6h, 5h and 4–4.5h, respectively. 
CarryScore
+1

*Approximate for two; transport and activity fees vary.

Three good options for Bengaluru:

Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters — Best all-rounder. Wide selection; beans currently around ₹650–₹750 for many 250g packs. Subscriptions can save up to 20%. 
Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters
+1

Third Wave Coffee — Good everyday option, especially if you prefer balanced, chocolatey profiles. Typically ~₹430–₹450/250g based on recent comparisons. 
Journal of a Coffee Enthusiast

Maverick & Farmer Coffee — Worth trying for more distinctive Indian single-estate coffees; they also have a Bengaluru roastery/café. Maverick & Farmer Coffee

What to look for: roast date (ideally within ~2–4 weeks), whole beans, origin/estate, roast level, tasting notes, and whether the roaster lets you choose grind size. For freshness, roast date matters more than “best before.”
